name: Plan Features
description: Feature flags, usage limits, and overage pricing per plan

category.description: Feature category for grouping in pricing UI

community_value.description: Community Edition value (AGPL-only self-host, no ee/ bridge). Typically 'true'/'unlimited' for core features and 'false' for ee/-dependent features.

enterprise_value.description: Enterprise plan value (number for limits, true/false for features, unlimited for Infinity)

free_value.description: Free plan value (number for limits, true/false for features)

key.description: Dot-notation key used in hasFeature() and getPlanLimit() (e.g. cdn.delivery, ai.messages_per_month)

overage_price.description: Per-unit overage price in USD (null if not applicable)

overage_settings_key.description: JSONB key used inside workspaces.overage_settings to toggle this overage (e.g. ai_messages, cdn_bandwidth). Required when overage_price is set.

overage_unit.description: Overage billing unit (e.g. per message, per GB, per submission)

requires_ee.description: Whether this feature requires the Enterprise Edition bridge (ee/) to function. When true, the feature is force-disabled in Community Edition regardless of plan-tier values.

roadmap.description: True when the feature appears in the plan matrix as marketing but has no runtime enforcement yet. UI surfaces show a 'Coming Soon' badge.

trial_cap_origins.description: Which trials the trial cap applies to: 'migrate' (trials started from a Migrate order) or 'all' (every trial). Only read when trial_cap_plan is set.

trial_cap_plan.description: During a trial, this limit is capped at the named plan's value (e.g. 'starter'). Metered usage in a trial is not billed, so the trial gets the lower allowance and the plan's own value opens with the first payment. Overage stays off while trialing.

type.description: Whether this entry is a boolean feature flag or a numeric limit
